session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trending Trading Range Day' (filename adds inside day at the close). Spans 1/26 13:00 through the 1/28 edge marker. Reading: opening shaded trading range (07:00-08:10) with a wedge Sell-The-Close top at 4421, a triangle (blue dotted) box and an LH DT at 4408 that broke out below the triangle (09:15) forming a lower trading range as the note projected; stepwise down through the second shaded range (10:00-13:15), a sell climax low (10:25), High 2 buy and LH DT rallies (4407.5/4404.5), two LL MTR up-reactions (11:30, 12:30) but no bull follow-through — closing inside the range ~4403.
